def factor_recovery_volume_pressure_stabilized(df):
    """Measure persistent recovery from a prior drawdown with bounded volume-pressure attenuation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    prior_peak = close.rolling(30, min_periods=30).max().shift(5).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    drawdown_depth = (1.0 - close.shift(5) / prior_peak).clip(lower=0.0, upper=0.8)
    prior_low = low.rolling(15, min_periods=15).min().shift(1).replace(0.0, np.nan)
    recovery = close / prior_low - 1.0
    recovery_score = recovery.ewm(span=4, adjust=False, min_periods=4).mean() - 0.5 * drawdown_depth
    log_volume = np.log(volume.clip(lower=1.0))
    safe_close = close.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    returns = safe_close.pct_change().replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    volume_pressure = returns.rolling(20, min_periods=20).corr(log_volume.diff()).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    confirmation_weight = 1.0 - 0.2 * np.tanh(volume_pressure)
    factor = recovery_score * (0.75 + 0.75 * drawdown_depth) * confirmation_weight
    df_copy["factor_recovery_volume_pressure_stabilized"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_recovery_volume_pressure_stabilized"]
